description: Content depth & game feel — tutorial flow, dialogue, quests, bosses, world systems. All logic-only, no visual/rendering changes.

userStories.title: Guided tutorial auto-trigger system
userStories.description: Build middleware that automatically triggers tutorial steps based on player actions. First-time feature use shows a contextual tutorial. Tutorial gates early gameplay so players learn mechanics in order: vocabulary → quiz → battle → crafting → quests.
acceptanceCriteria: tutorialMiddleware listens for first-use of each feature and dispatches tutorial triggers
Tutorial sequence: vocab_intro → first_quiz → first_battle → crafting_intro → quest_intro
Each step has a prerequisite (previous step completed)
skipTutorial() action skips all remaining steps for experienced players
Tutorial state persisted in onboardingSlice (extend existing slice)
selectNextTutorialStep(state) returns next incomplete step or null
selectTutorialComplete(state) returns true when all steps done
Tests: 14+ tests covering sequence, skip, persistence, gate logic
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read onboardingSlice.js for existing state. Extend it, don't replace. Read featureIntroductions.js and onboardingTips.js for existing data. Middleware pattern from quizDailyGoalsMiddleware.

userStories.title: Dialogue choice tracking and world state effects
userStories.description: Build a system that records dialogue choices and applies world state consequences. Choices can affect faction alignment, NPC relationships, quest availability, and unlock hidden content. Each choice has a weight and consequence definition.
acceptanceCriteria: recordDialogueChoice(npcId, choiceId, consequences) stores choice and applies effects
Consequence types: factionChange(factionId, amount), relationshipChange(npcId, amount), questUnlock(questId), itemGrant(itemId)
getDialogueHistory(npcId) returns all choices made with that NPC
hasChosenOption(npcId, choiceId) check for branching future dialogue
dialogueChoiceMiddleware applies consequences to respective slices on choice
selectNpcDialogueFlags(npcId) returns set of flags for Ink variable binding
Tests: 14+ tests covering choice recording, each consequence type, history, flags
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read narrativeSlice.js or npcSlice.js for dialogue history. Store choices in a dialogueChoiceSlice or extend narrative. Consequences dispatch to factionSlice, companionSlice, questSlice, inventorySlice.

userStories.title: Zone boss encounter data and logic
userStories.description: Create boss encounter data and challenge logic for all 8 zones. Each zone has a unique boss with special mechanics tied to that zone's vocabulary theme. Boss fights require answering vocabulary questions to deal damage.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/zoneBosses.js with 8 boss definitions (one per zone)
Each boss: id, name, zone, level, hp, arabicTitle, specialMechanic, vocabTheme, rewards, dialogue
Special mechanics: timed_vocab (answer in 5s), root_match (identify root), dictation (type what you hear), etc.
getBossForZone(zoneId) returns boss data
isBossDefeated(zoneId, playerState) checks completion
calculateBossDamage(answerCorrect, timeBonus, combo) returns damage dealt
Boss rewards: unique equipment item + large XP + faction reputation
Tests: 14+ tests covering boss data, damage calc, completion tracking, all 8 zones
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read zones.js for zone IDs and themes. Read battleOpponents.js for opponent data format. Bosses are data + pure functions, not Phaser scenes. Store defeat state in worldStateSlice.

userStories.title: Weather and time-of-day system
userStories.description: Build a time and weather system that tracks in-game time and weather per zone. Time cycles through dawn/day/dusk/night (each period = 15 real minutes). Weather affects NPC availability and shop inventory. Pure state management, no rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/slices/worldTimeSlice.js tracks currentTime (0-59 minutes cycle) and weather per zone
Time periods: dawn(0-14), day(15-29), dusk(30-44), night(45-59)
getCurrentTimePeriod(state) returns dawn|day|dusk|night
Weather types: clear, sandstorm, rain, fog — each zone has weighted probabilities
Weather changes every time period (roll on zone's probability table)
getActiveNpcs(zoneId, timePeriod) filters NPCs by their schedule field
worldTimeMiddleware advances clock every real minute
Tests: 14+ tests covering time cycling, weather generation, NPC schedules, period transitions
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read zones.js — NPCs already have schedule fields. Weather is new. Use deterministic seeded random for weather so it's testable. Middleware uses setInterval internally.

userStories.title: Custom FSRS deck management
userStories.description: Let players create custom vocabulary decks for focused review. Decks can be created by zone, CEFR level, category, or manual word selection. Review sessions can target a specific deck instead of the full pool.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/slices/deckSlice.js manages custom decks: create, delete, add/remove words
createDeck(name, filter) creates deck — filter can be: zone, cefrLevel, category, or manual wordIds
Auto-decks: generateDeckByZone(zoneId), generateDeckByCefr(level), generateDeckByCategory(cat)
getSessionCardsFromDeck(deckId, maxCards) returns due cards filtered to deck
Max 10 custom decks per player
selectDeckStats(deckId) returns card count, due count, average retrievability
Tests: 14+ tests covering create, filter types, session generation, limits, stats
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read vocabularySlice.js for card structure. Read fsrs.js for getDueCards and getSessionCards. Decks store wordId arrays, not card copies. Filter at review time.

userStories.title: Companion dialogue progression
userStories.description: Create a dialogue progression system where companion conversations change based on relationship level. Each companion has 5 dialogue tiers (stranger→acquaintance→friend→close→bonded) with unique lines, hints, and backstory reveals.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/companionDialogue.js with dialogue for all 12 companions across 5 tiers
Tiers: stranger(0-19), acquaintance(20-39), friend(40-59), close(60-79), bonded(80-100)
Each tier has: greeting, idle lines (3+), hint (gameplay tip), backstoryReveal (lore)
getCompanionDialogue(companionId, relationshipLevel) returns tier-appropriate dialogue
selectActiveCompanionGreeting(state) returns greeting for currently active companion
Backstory reveals unlock codex entries (dispatch to codex slice)
Tests: 12+ tests covering tier selection, all companions have data, codex unlock
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read companionSlice.js for relationship state and companion IDs. Read companionBackstories.js for existing lore. Dialogue is Arabic+English pairs. Keep lines short (1-2 sentences).

userStories.title: NPC stat-aware dialogue lines
userStories.description: Add contextual dialogue lines that NPCs say based on player stats. NPCs comment on player's CEFR level, faction alignment, quest progress, and vocabulary count. Makes NPCs feel aware of the player's journey.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/npcContextDialogue.js with stat-aware lines for 20+ NPCs
Condition types: cefrLevel (A1-C2), factionTier (per faction), vocabCount (thresholds), questComplete (quest IDs)
getNpcContextLine(npcId, playerState) returns most relevant contextual line or null
Priority: quest-specific > faction > CEFR > vocab count > null (most specific wins)
Each NPC has 5-10 contextual lines with conditions
Lines are Arabic + English pairs
Tests: 12+ tests covering condition matching, priority ordering, fallback to null
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read npcs.json for NPC IDs and zones. Pure data file + selector function. Context lines supplement existing dialogue, don't replace it.

userStories.title: Faction vendor discounts and exclusive shop inventory
userStories.description: Wire faction reputation to the shop system. Higher faction tiers unlock exclusive items in faction-aligned shops and provide progressive discounts. Each faction has a signature shop with 5 exclusive items unlocked across tiers.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/factionShops.js with 6 faction shops, each with 5 exclusive items
getShopInventory(factionId, playerTier) returns available items for player's tier
getFactionDiscount(factionId, playerTier) returns discount: Novice=0%, Initiate=5%, Ally=10%, Champion=15%, Hero=25%
applyFactionDiscount(basePrice, factionId, playerState) returns discounted price
Exclusive items: tier-gated (1 item per tier, cumulative)
selectAvailableFactionShops(state) returns shops where player has Initiate+ standing
Tests: 12+ tests covering discount calc, inventory gating, all 6 factions, tier progression
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read factionSlice.js for tier calculation. Read economySlice.js for shop/pricing patterns. Faction shop items should be thematic (Scholars sell books, Warriors sell weapons, etc.).

userStories.title: Quest branching and failure states
userStories.description: Add branching paths and failure conditions to the quest system. Quests can have multiple objectives with choice points. Failed quests can be retried. Some quests have timed objectives that fail if not completed within the session.
acceptanceCriteria: Quest schema extended: branchPoints[] with choiceId→nextObjective mapping
makeQuestChoice(questId, choiceId) advances quest down chosen branch
failQuest(questId, reason) marks quest as failed with retry option
retryQuest(questId) resets progress to last checkpoint (or start)
Timed objectives: quest.timeLimit (minutes) triggers failure if exceeded
questTimerMiddleware tracks active timed quests and dispatches failure
selectActiveTimedQuests(state) returns quests with running timers
Tests: 14+ tests covering branching, failure, retry, timers, checkpoint reset
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read questSlice.js for existing quest state model. Extend it — don't break existing quests. Add optional fields (branchPoints, timeLimit) that default to null for existing quests.

userStories.title: Quest content expansion — 30 new quests
userStories.description: Add 30 new quests to quests.json expanding coverage across all 8 zones. Mix of side quests (vocabulary challenges, NPC fetch quests, crafting commissions) and faction quests (reputation-gated, faction-specific rewards). Each quest has Arabic title and description.
acceptanceCriteria: 30 new quests added to src/data/quests.json (total ~93+)
Distribution: 3-4 new quests per zone across all 8 zones
Types: 10 side quests, 10 faction quests (faction field set), 5 crafting quests, 5 vocabulary challenge quests
Each quest has: id, title, titleArabic, description, zone, type, target, prerequisites, reward, npcGiver
Faction quests require minimum faction tier as prerequisite
Rewards scale with quest difficulty (higher zone = better rewards)
Validation: npm run validate-quests passes (if script exists)
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read existing quests.json for format and IDs. Follow existing naming convention (kebab-case IDs). Use existing NPC IDs from npcs.json. Arabic titles should be simple MSA. Don't duplicate existing quest objectives.
